## About
Caspian Business Group (کاسپین گروپ) is a licensed travel, immigration, and business services company based in Yerevan, Armenia. Founded with a focus on serving Persian-speaking (Iranian/Farsi) travelers and immigrants, the company also serves Russian and English-speaking clients.

Website: https://caspian.am
WhatsApp: +37433149327
Email: info@caspian.am
Address: No. 49 Komitas Avenue, Yerevan, Armenia

Languages: Persian (Farsi) — primary, Russian, English

## Core Services

### Hotel & Apartment Booking in Yerevan
- Hotel reservations in Yerevan: 3-star to 5-star, with official booking voucher accepted by embassies for visa applications
- Furnished apartment rentals in Yerevan: daily (from $30/night) and monthly (from $300/month)
- Payment accepted: Iranian Rial bank transfer, cash USD, USDT cryptocurrency
- Airport transfer from Zvartnots International Airport (EVN) included on request
- WhatsApp-based booking with real unit photos sent before confirmation

### Armenia Residency (اقامت ارمنستان)
- Company registration-based residency: fastest route, LLC registered in 3 working days
- Work residency: through employment at Armenian companies
- Student residency: university admission + residency card
- Residency card issued within 20–40 days
- Full family reunification support (spouse + children under 18)

### Company Registration in Armenia (ثبت شرکت ارمنستان)
- LLC registration in 3 working days
- Simplified tax: 5% of revenue (for turnover under 115M AMD / ~$290K/year)
- Standard corporate tax: 18%
- Personal income tax: 10%
- 100% foreign ownership — no Armenian partner required
- International bank account (Visa/Mastercard) opened after registration
- Banks: ACBA, Converse Bank, Ameriabank, IDBank

### Russia Tourist Visa (ویزای توریستی روسیه)
- eVisa: $70–$110, processed in 4 business days, up to 16-day stay, no invitation letter required
- Embassy sticker visa from Yerevan Russian Embassy: $130–$160, 5–10 business days, up to 30-day stay
- Official invitation letter (voucher) arranged for embassy visas

### Armenia Student Visa & University Admission (ویزای تحصیلی ارمنستان)
- Admission to: Yerevan State University (YSU), Armenian Medical University (YSMU), American University of Armenia (AUA), Slavonic University (RAU)
- Tuition: from $1,500/year (YSU) to $10,000/year (AUA)
- Medicine programs available in English and Russian

### Other Services
- Schengen visa assistance from Yerevan
- Romania visa
- Student visas for Russia, Turkey, Georgia, Schengen
- Flight booking from Yerevan (EVN) to Tehran (IKA/THR), Moscow (SVO/DME), Dubai (DXB)
- Airport transfer and VIP support
